text:
micah: reopening thread for tracking follow-ups after last night's shard OOMs (shard-30 & shard-31). Observed similar fragmentation pattern but slightly different tail: more frequent small alloc churn + occasional 12MB temp buffers.

lena: Copy. We need a concrete remediation plan and owners so this doesn't drift. Quick wins first, long-term later.

jorge: I'll own immediate allocator/path changes. Action: add allocation tags to InsertBatch and insert path, add microbench harness that simulates concurrent small writes + periodic large writes. ETA: prototype by Thu EOD.

adarsh: I'll own GC/compaction experiments. Plan: run a canary with compact-on-GC enabled and lower GC trigger by 10% for one shard ring. Measure CPU/train vs frag ratio. ETA: Mon 09:00 for metrics.

emily: Ops mitigation: deploying soft cap on single-request put size (8MB) and an emergency shard-fallback that migrates hot shards to spare capacity when frag ratio > 0.5. I'll open PR and start a 30m canary.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0460 (kv-cache OOM cluster)  paging eng-runtime oncall.

micah: Notes from quick pprof: top allocation sites - InsertBatcher/AllocTemp, bytes.MakeSlice, slice growth in marshal.Encode. GC pause times increase near OOMs but don't reclaim fragmentation efficiently.

lena: Action items summary (add to ticket INC-2026-0460):
- jorge: instrumentation + microbench (Thu EOD)
- adarsh: compaction canary + dashboard panels (Mon 09:00)
- emily: ops soft-cap + shard fallback PR + canary (2h)
- micah: attach pprofs + repro steps + candidate rollback if needed

jorge: small tip for repro: run `KV_TEST_WORKLOAD=burst ./kv-sim --shards=1 --seed=42` and then `kv-tool inspect-frag --hist` right after a burst. That reproducer reliably triggers frag ratio > 0.6 in the harness.

emily: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/PR-827 (soft-cap + fallback). Canary at 5% for 20m. No OOMs so far. Rolling to 25%.

adarsh: I'll create dashboard tile KVR-248: frag_ratio, heap_live, gc_pause_ms, cpu_util. Also adding an alert `kv.cache.frag_ratio >= 0.5 for 5m` -> page eng-runtime.

micah: We should also add a weekly automated scan that looks for clusters of frag alerts and correlates with deploys. Who can own that?

lena: I'll take the weekly scan for now and will rotate after 4 weeks. Adding calendar invite and a short template for the scan notes.

jorge: After instrumentation lands I'll try two patches: (A) avoid large temporary buffers by streaming encode, (B) fall back to smaller preallocated pools. Will benchmark both.

emily: Canary promoted to 25% with no regressions. Rolling to 100% during low-traffic window in 3h. Will coordinate with adarsh for compaction test to avoid concurrent risky deploys.

micah: Final note: let's lock owners into the incident ticket and set a postmortem owner when incident is quiet. Propose jorge+adarsh as co-owners.

lena: Agree. Assign provisional postmortem to jorge+adarsh. We'll finalize in 24h.

ops-bot: Reminder: Incident review scheduled in 24h for INC-2026-0460.

micah: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here and in the incident. :thumbsup:
